evals.name: asyncapi3-operation-reply-lint

fixture.note: repo state before AsyncAPI 3 LS validation (PR #5104); operation-reply lint index files are empty

evals.prompt: Add apidom-ls lint rules for the AsyncAPI 3.0 Operation Reply Object and Operation Reply Address Object (packages/apidom-ls/src/config/asyncapi/operation-reply and operation-reply-address). Write the complete rule files and lint/index.ts for both, plus the codes.ts additions as a snippet, mirroring repo paths.
evals.expected_output: Complete, repo-consistent lint rules (allowed fields, types, required, $ref) for both objects.
assertions: Operation Reply allowed-fields rule lists exactly address, channel, messages, $ref with x- extensions
Operation Reply Address allowed-fields rule lists exactly description, location, $ref with x- extensions
location required rule uses message "should always have a 'location'" and is conditional on $ref being absent
location type message does not mention runtime expression
address and channel type rules check the element class (operationReplyAddress / channel), not a plain object type
Rule file names follow {field}--{type}.ts (optionally a version suffix)
Every rule is scoped with targetSpecs AsyncAPI3
description type rule exists for Operation Reply Address
Every rule file is registered in its lint/index.ts
Rule files contain no explanatory code comments

evals.name: a2a-ls-coverage-pr5182

fixture.note: PR #5182 (A2A) after its first LS commit; review then found 29 coverage gaps and 16 wrong doc links

evals.prompt: Complete the apidom-ls configuration for A2A 1.0 (namespace packages/apidom-ns-a2a-1, config packages/apidom-ls/src/config/a2a) so that every A2A object has completion, hover documentation and lint rules. Don't write tests.
evals.expected_output: Config directories and metas for every A2A element, per-field docs/completion/type rules, required rules per spec, verified doc links.
assertions: Registers metas in config.ts for apiKeySecurityScheme, httpAuthSecurityScheme, oauth2SecurityScheme, openIdConnectSecurityScheme, mutualTlsSecurityScheme and agentExtension
Adds scopes--required rules to the authorization code, client credentials and device code OAuth flows
Adds location--required and name--required (API key), scheme--required (HTTP auth), flows--required (OAuth2), openIdConnectUrl required (OpenID Connect)
Adds a location--equals rule (query, header, cookie) using apilintValueOrArray, not a --value file
Adds documentation entries for scalar fields such as Agent Card name, description and version
Removes or does not add config for the implicit and password OAuth flows (removed in A2A 1.0)
Runs check-ls-coverage.mjs and verify-urls.mjs and reports their results
